descriptionYoutube:
What do you do when the disaster you're supposed to help others survive is happening to YOU at the same time?

Daral Boles — trauma therapist and author of 'The Serra Is Burning' — lived through Portugal's longest-running wildfire while running a mental health retreat for vulnerable clients. What she brought home wasn't just survival. It was a framework for finding meaning inside the worst chapter of your life.

In this episode, Daral shares the raw, unfiltered story of that year — the evacuation, the burn zone, the health complications — and why she would do it all again. If you're in the middle of something you never would have chosen, this conversation was made for you.

You'll hear:
— Why gratitude after trauma is work, not just a mindset shift
— How a client's charcoal drawing became one of the most powerful healing moments of Daral's career
— The therapeutic writing method Daral teaches — and used herself — to process what felt unprocessable
— What it really means to find the 'gifts' inside a crisis you'd never have chosen
— How one devastating year in Portugal became a memoir, a method, and a new mission

Daral's book, 'The Serra Is Burning: A Memoir of Fire, Trauma, and the Search for Healing,' is accompanied by a full photo portfolio — before, during, and after the fire — available on her website.

descriptionWebsite: If you are searching for wildfire trauma recovery stories or trying to understand how to rebuild your life after a devastating crisis, this episode of the Limitless Living Podcast speaks directly to that experience. Trauma therapist and author Daral Boles spent a year running a mental health retreat in the mountains of Eastern Portugal — a year that was upended by the country's longest-running wildfire in recorded history. Daral and her clients were evacuated, returned to a burn zone, and faced months of physical and psychological aftermath. Rather than leave the experience behind, Daral processed it through therapeutic writing, producing her memoir 'The Serra Is Burning.' In this honest, deeply moving conversation, she explores the paradox at the heart of trauma recovery: you would never have chosen it, and yet the experience carries real gifts — courage, compassion, acceptance, and strength. Daral also introduces the practice of therapeutic journaling as an accessible tool for anyone working through a personal crisis or life transition. A powerful listen for anyone facing grief, health challenges, or an unexpected life upheaval.
